claims.claim: The conjugation probe tests the intended circuit and route identities.
claims.reason_summary: It negates only the RZ angle coordinate for both keys and queries, reconstructs the original states, and checks the transformed states against their complex conjugates. It compares all four conjugated positive-time probability arrays with the original negative-time arrays and checks native invariance separately.

claims.claim: The coherent current, commutator and Bargmann reweighting have consistent orientations.
claims.reason_summary: The broadcast product at [r,i,j] is H_ij a_rj conj(a_ri). Row sums therefore give incoming probability derivatives, and the upper-triangle contraction uses u_ri−u_rj. Right multiplication of row-stored amplitudes by h.T implements H acting on a column, giving the stated i[H,V] sign. The cubic-minus-linear check uses the same oriented triangle with separately normalized edge weights. The native denominator retains Nε; the constant ε numerator has zero derivative.

claims.claim: The finite-time certificate applies to the measured cubic odd contrast.
claims.reason_summary: The code subtracts the dephased logit at each time before taking the odd part. Absolute Hermitian eigenvalues summed per query give the trace norm of the normalized off-diagonal density. At τ=1/4 the remainder bound is width times trace norm divided by 96; the sign test requires |τj| to exceed that bound plus tolerance. It does not assume the dephased logit is even.

claims.claim: The numerical derivatives and all-target CE comparisons test the stated quantities.
claims.reason_summary: The fixed central difference checks coherent logit slopes and the zero dephased slope at the origin. For each possible target y, the CE derivative is the native-softmax mean slope minus slope[y], and the finite change is the log-partition change minus the target-logit change. Local-to-finite sign agreement is counted only for pairs above the stated thresholds, not treated as a certificate.

claims.claim: The new dispatch stays within the bounded diagnostic contract.
claims.reason_summary: The pinned analysis selector calls run_current and returns before either prior analysis. The branch materializes only the nine named arrays, checks finite inputs, replays the sealed probabilities and logits, and uses the inherited two-output path without training. The source identity includes the diagnostic script, design and current-orientation theory.

scope_limits: Static review against the supplied interfaces and identities, not an observed execution. The six-trace run must establish actual replay, shapes and numerical tolerance compliance on the assigned device.

The launch contract's focused_test prose describes nuisance-mode checks. For this selector the operative checks are those in current_measurement; completion would not attest nuisance CE bounds or winner certification.

The angle-level intervention checks the circuit consequence on six frozen states, not a parameter transformation on every input. All-target sign counts are descriptive, not labeled task utility, novelty or L5 evidence.
